tools.description: Search award flight availability across every airline currently LIVE for a route and date, in parallel. tools.name: search_availability
tools.description: Search live award availability for a specific airline, route, and date. 30 airlines can be requested, but only those list_supported_airlines reports as live are returning seats right now — when a source is down, blocked, or needs a member login the result says so explicitly instead of reporting zero

tools.name: list_supported_airlines
tools.description: List the airlines ATF can search for award seats, with their LIVE status: which returned real award data in the last 72h, which are degraded (source down, blocked, or behind a member login) and which are idle. search_all_airlines only fans out to live sources, so call this before promising coverage

tools.name: search_monthly_availability
tools.description: Search award flight availability for an entire month. Returns day-by-day availability with points costs. Renders as an interactive rate calendar. Paid feature.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get the award pricing chart for a specific airline route. Shows points required per cabin class (off-peak/peak). No date needed. Paid feature.

tools.name: search_hybrid
tools.description: Find the cheapest way to fly by combining cash tickets with award redemptions into one split-ticket journey. tools.name: get_award_trip_details
tools.description: Get flight-level detail for one award result from search_all_airlines or search_availability: flight numbers, aircraft, departure/arrival times, stops, and direct booking links into the mileage programme. Pass the `trip_id` from a seats.aero result row. Requires a connected seats.aero account.

tools.name: get_program_rates
tools.description: Get the full award chart rates for a specific loyalty program. Returns all destinations with points required per cabin class including off-peak/peak pricing. Free — no account needed.

tools.name: get_buy_points_pricing
tools.description: Get the cost to buy points/miles for a loyalty program. Returns tiered base purchase pricing and any active bonus promotion. Use to answer 'how much does it cost to buy X Avios/miles/points?' If no program specified, returns all programs with pricing data. Free — no account needed.

tools.name: get_status_matches
tools.description: Get current airline status match offers. Returns active promotions where you can match elite status from one airline to another. Includes direct apply links. Each program also has a detailed FAQ page at awardtravelfinder.com/status-match/{program-slug} with eligibility, requirements, and step-by-ste

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Search for hotels by name, city, or brand. Returns hotel codes needed for availability checks and price monitoring. Supports Marriott, Hilton, IHG, and Hyatt. Paid feature.

tools.name: get_hotel_availability
tools.description: Get current points availability for a hotel on specific dates. Use BEFORE monitor_hotel_price to find the correct rate_plan and current points rate. Paid feature.

tools.name: monitor_hotel_price
tools.description: Start monitoring a hotel points booking for price drops. Checks daily and sends email alerts when the points rate decreases. Paid feature.

tools.name: add_hotel_booking
tools.description: Log a hotel booking to the user's portfolio — award (points, with price-drop monitoring) or cash (paid with money; set kind:"cash" and original_pay_rate_usd). tools.name: list_hotel_bookings
tools.description: List all hotel bookings being monitored for price drops. Shows current vs. original points rates.

tools.name: get_hotel_booking
tools.description: Get details and full price history of a monitored hotel booking.

tools.name: update_hotel_booking
tools.description: Update a tracked hotel booking — correct dates, room type, points, rate, confirmation number, etc. Do NOT use this to cancel a booking — use delete_hotel_booking instead.

tools.name: delete_hotel_booking
tools.description: Remove a tracked hotel booking from the user's portfolio. Use when the trip is cancelled or the booking was added by mistake.

tools.name: add_flight_booking
tools.description: Log a flight booking/redemption — award (points) or cash (paid with money; set kind:"cash" and cash_paid). tools.name: list_flight_bookings
tools.description: List all tracked flight award bookings/redemptions. Shows airlines, routes, points spent, and cabin classes.

tools.name: get_flight_booking
tools.description: Get details of a specific flight booking/redemption.

tools.name: update_flight_booking
tools.description: Update a tracked flight booking. Use to correct details or add confirmation numbers. Do NOT use this to cancel a booking — use delete_flight_booking instead.

tools.name: delete_flight_booking
tools.description: Cancel or remove a tracked flight booking. Use this when the user says the flight is cancelled, superseded, no longer happening, or asks to remove/archive it.

tools.name: list_voucher_types
tools.description: Browse the catalogue of companion & upgrade voucher types (UK + US): BA Amex companion (Travel Together), Barclaycard/Lloyds Avios upgrade vouchers, Virgin Atlantic companion, Delta/American/Alaska companion certificates, Southwest Companion Pass, United PlusPoints. Optionally filter by region (UK/U

tools.name: list_my_vouchers
tools.description: List the companion/upgrade vouchers the user holds, including which booking each is applied to. Paid feature.

tools.name: add_voucher
tools.description: Add a companion/upgrade voucher the user holds to their inventory. Use list_voucher_types to find the voucher_slug. Paid feature.

tools.name: apply_voucher_to_booking
tools.description: Apply a held voucher to a flight or hotel booking (e.g. a BA companion voucher onto a flight redemption, or a Barclaycard upgrade voucher onto a Club World leg). Omit booking_id to detach the voucher. Paid feature.

tools.name: delete_voucher
tools.description: Remove a voucher from the user's inventory.

tools.name: update_points_balance
tools.description: Update your points/miles balance for a loyalty program. Creates the program if it doesn't exist, or updates the balance if it does. Use with Gmail to extract balance notifications and keep your portfolio current. Paid feature.

tools.name: list_points_balances
tools.description: List all your loyalty program points/miles balances.

tools.name: delete_points_balance
tools.description: Remove a loyalty program from your points balances — e.g. you closed the account or added it by mistake. Use the program name as shown by list_points_balances. Paid feature.

tools.name: set_loyalty_status
tools.description: Record or update the user's elite/loyalty status with an airline or hotel program (e.g. Marriott Bonvoy Titanium, BA Executive Club Gold, AA Executive Platinum). Knowing this lets the assistant flag perks like free breakfast, suite upgrades, lounge access, and free award nights when planning trips.

tools.name: list_loyalty_statuses
tools.description: List the user's tracked elite/loyalty statuses across airlines and hotels.

tools.name: delete_loyalty_status
tools.description: Remove a tracked elite/loyalty status (e.g. when it lapses and the user doesn't want to renew it).

tools.name: set_status_progress
tools.description: Update the user's qualifying progress toward an elite tier — their current tier-points / XP / Loyalty Points / qualifying nights, the date their qualifying year ends, and (optionally) a target tier they're chasing. Use this to answer 'how far am I from BA Gold?'. If no status is tracked for the prog

tools.name: get_status_progress
tools.description: Show the user's progress toward elite status across all their tracked loyalty programs — for each: current tier, qualifying balance, the next tier's threshold and what it unlocks, how far they are from it, and their requalification date. Answers 'how close am I to my next tier?' and 'what would the

tools.name: calculate_flight_earnings
tools.description: Estimate the ELITE-QUALIFYING points a flight earns toward status — British Airways Tier Points, Air France/KLM Flying Blue XP, or American AAdvantage Loyalty Points — plus the great-circle distance. Answers 'how many tier points is LHR–JFK in business?' and 'how many BA tier points for a £600 fare?

tools.name: recommend_status_path
tools.description: Recommend the cheapest path to an elite tier — EARN it through planned flying, RUN for it (a tier-point run), or MATCH/challenge into it from a status the user already holds. Uses the user's tracked statuses, booked flights, and the status-match graph. Answers 'what's the easiest way to get Qatar Go

tools.name: get_award_release_window
tools.description: Look up when an airline opens award seats for booking (days from departure). Use this before searching for a date >330 days out to warn the user if inventory hasn't been loaded yet, and to suggest the right retry date or a route monitor.

tools.name: list_award_release_windows
tools.description: List all known per-airline award booking windows. Useful when the user asks 'when do award seats open?' generally.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Get a complete summary of your travel rewards portfolio for signed-in users: points balances, spend on hotels and flights, upcoming and past trips, destinations, and monthly spending trends. Uses the same underlying snapshot as the server-loaded chat preamble; call after the user adds bookings or ba

tools.name: log_lounge_visit
tools.description: Log an airport lounge visit to your portfolio: which lounge, airport, date, how you got in (Priority Pass, card, status, ticket), an optional 1-5 rating, and notes. Use with the lounge_* lookup tools to confirm the lounge name first. Paid feature.

tools.name: list_lounge_visits
tools.description: List the airport lounge visits you've logged to your portfolio.

tools.name: delete_lounge_visit
tools.description: Remove a lounge visit you previously logged with log_lounge_visit. Use list_lounge_visits to find the visit id. Paid feature.

tools.name: discover_more_flight_tools
tools.description: Discover other flight & travel MCP servers you can add to your client. tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: List the external services the user can connect (seats.aero, AwardWallet, etc.) and their current connection status. Call this before any flight/hotel search if you suspect a connection is missing.

tools.name: connect_integration
tools.description: Initiate the OAuth flow to connect an external integration. Returns the authorize URL; the user must open it in a browser to grant access. Use this when a tool returns connection_required.

tools.name: disconnect_integration
tools.description: Revoke a previously connected integration. The OAuth tokens are deleted from ATF storage.

tools.name: sync_now
tools.description: Trigger an immediate refresh of the user's connected integrations (AwardWallet, Google Sheets, …) so balances/bookings are current before you answer. Use when the user asks to refresh, or when list_integrations shows stale data. Returns which connections are syncing.

tools.name: whats_on_sale
tools.description: List currently-active points sales: buy-points promos (airline + hotel) and transfer bonuses across credit-card and loyalty programs. No auth required. Useful as a starting point when a user asks 'what's a good deal right now?'.

tools.name: recommend_redemption
tools.description: Recommend the optimal points strategy for a specific trip given the user's known points balances. Combines active award availability + transfer bonuses + the user's portfolio. Premium tier.

tools.name: audit_marriott_folio
tools.description: Audit a Marriott Bonvoy folio for commonly-disputable charges (resort fee on award stays, parking double-billing, destination fee, internet). Returns a finding list with a dispute template. Premium tier.

tools.name: compare_transfer_options
tools.description: Decide which points to use for a specific redemption. tools.name: find_transfer_paths

Surfaces non-obvious second-hop routes through hotel programs, applies live transfer bonuses, and computes source points needed. Use when a ca

tools.name: create_route_monitor
tools.description: Create a saved route monitor. ATF checks every 6 hours for award seats matching the route + window + cabin and emails when fresh availability appears. Free accounts get one monitor; Premium is unlimited.

tools.name: list_route_monitors
tools.description: List the user's saved route monitors with their last-checked time and current status.

tools.name: update_route_monitor
tools.description: Edit a saved route monitor by ID — change the date window, cabin, airline filter, passenger count, max-points cap, or pause/resume it.

tools.name: cancel_route_monitor
tools.description: Cancel an active route monitor by ID. Cancelled monitors stop firing but are preserved for history.

tools.name: create_standing_order
tools.description: Save a recurring instruction ATF runs for the user unattended, then emails the result. tools.name: list_standing_orders
tools.description: List the user's standing orders — the recurring instructions ATF runs unattended — with their schedule, next run time, and the result of the last run.

tools.name: cancel_standing_order
tools.description: Stop a standing order by ID so it no longer runs. The record is kept, including its last result.

tools.name: search_multi_passenger
tools.description: Find award seats for a group — filters out single-seat phantom availability. Returns only carriers reporting seats >= the requested passenger count. Premium tier.

tools.name: audit_hotel_folio
tools.description: Audit a hotel folio for commonly-disputable charges. Supports Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, and IHG. Returns a finding list with a chain-aware dispute template. Premium tier.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Plan an end-to-end award trip in one call. Searches all airlines, ranks options against the user's balances + active transfer bonuses, and surfaces the best route — including transfer paths if the user is short on points. Premium tier.

tools.name: search_cash_flights
tools.description: Real cash flight prices via Duffel (GDS) and Ignav (REST). Use to compare cash vs award redemptions or to surface the cheapest cash option for a route. Returns price + airline + flight number + cabin per option. Hosted keys — no per-user setup.

tools.name: find_premium_hotels
tools.description: Find Amex Fine Hotels & Resorts (FHR), Amex The Hotel Collection (THC), or Chase Edit hotels in a city. These programs stack benefits worth $300+: breakfast, F&B credits, room upgrades, late checkout. Use when the user wants premium hotel options that maximize portal stacking.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List the reference skills available — institutional knowledge the agent can pull in on demand. Each skill explains a sub-domain (sweet spots, hold rules, cabin codes, etc). Free, no auth required.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Fetch the full markdown body of a reference skill by key. Use when planning multi-step workflows where the skill's rules matter.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search the Miles & Points Daily + Smart With Points editorial archive for explainers and strategy. Retur

tools.name: wikipedia_airports
tools.description: Look up airline service from a Wikipedia airport page. Use when fare/award tools say a route doesn't exist (false negative on small markets) or when you need the full destination list for an airport. Free, no auth.

tools.name: get_earning_rates
tools.description: Look up mileage earning rates for crediting a partner-airline ticket to a loyalty program. Returns the % of distance earned per booking class. Use when deciding which program to credit a flight to. Free.

tools.name: get_partner_award_options
tools.description: Given an operating airline and a route, list which loyalty programmes can book that airline as a PARTNER and how many points it costs per cabin. tools.name: get_program_partner_chart
tools.description: Get a loyalty programme's PARTNER airline award chart (the points to book partner-operated flights), as a region-pair or distance-band table with sources, confidence, and accuracy caveats. Supported: aeroplan (Air Canada), aadvantage (American), singapore-krisflyer, cathay-asia-miles (distance-based

tools.name: lookup_flight
tools.description: Identify the airline behind a pasted flight code (e.g. 'BA117', 'AA 1234'). Returns carrier name, country, and — when ATF supports the airline — the slug and loyalty program so the assistant can pre-fill an add_flight_booking call. Use this any time a user pastes or types a raw flight code without c

tools.name: get_trip_briefing
tools.description: Combine FlightSeatmap and FlightQueue data for a planned flight: aircraft and seatmap availability plus airport delay and security-wait snapshots. Use when a user asks how to prepare for a flight or wants one live flight brief.

tools.name: list_trips
tools.description: List the signed-in user's trips (their trip-as-project workspaces) with destination, dates, status, and itinerary section count.

tools.name: create_trip
tools.description: Create a new trip (a project workspace grouping chats, searches, monitors, and bookings). Free accounts get one active trip; additional active trips require Premium.

tools.name: delete_trip
tools.description: Archive a trip, or delete it permanently. Archiving keeps the trip and its itinerary but frees the active-trip slot; bookings, monitors and chats filed under it are always kept and simply unfiled.

tools.name: assign_bookings_to_trip
tools.description: File existing flight and/or hotel bookings under a workspace Trip so the portfolio shows them grouped as one trip. Get the trip id from list_trips / create_trip and booking ids from list_flight_bookings / list_hotel_bookings. Pass an empty array (or omit) for a booking type you're not moving.

tools.name: update_itinerary
tools.description: Write a section onto a trip's itinerary canvas — the persistent, editable trip document the agent builds. Appends a new section, or updates an existing one when section_id is given. Returns the full updated canvas. Premium tier (itinerary canvas).

tools.name: search_my_documents
tools.description: Search the user's OWN uploaded documents (award charts, hotel folios, itineraries, statements) and return ranked excerpts. tools.name: search_merchant_multipliers
tools.description: Search a community-verified database of merchant bonus-category multipliers (e.g. 'which merchants earn 4x?', 'does Whole Foods earn a bonus on Amex Gold?'). tools.name: get_points_valuation
tools.description: Get the cents-per-point valuation for a credit-card points/miles currency or hotel program — answers "what is a Chase/Amex/Capital One/Avios/Marriott/Hyatt point worth?". Returns the headline cents-per-point, the value we've actually observed across logged redemptions (with sample size) when availab

tools.name: get_cancellation_fee
tools.description: Get the award-ticket cancellation/redeposit fee for an airline's OWN loyalty programme (e.g. British Airways Avios, Qatar Privilege Club, Virgin Atlantic Flying Club). Returns the headline fee, who is exempt (elite tiers), and a source link. Accepts a slug or a loose airline name. NOTE: fees for boo

tools.name: get_award_chart_faq
tools.description: Get curated award-chart FAQs, sweet spots, and booking tips for a loyalty programme (e.g. Aeroplan, British Airways Avios, AAdvantage, Flying Blue, World of Hyatt). Use to answer questions about a programme's award pricing, best redemptions, and how to book. Accepts a programme slug OR a loose name.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Email a user's confirmed feedback or bug report to Award Travel Finder support. Use this when the user explicitly wants to report a bug, share feedback, request an improvement, or report an incorrect AI result. Collect a concise summary and details first; for bugs, collect reproduction steps and exp

tools.name: fs_get_seatmap
tools.description: Get the seat map for a flight from our database. Shows all seats, cabin classes, characteristics, and availability as both text and an interactive visual seatmap. Returns cached data — for fresh/updated data, use search_flight (sign in via OAuth).

tools.name: fs_find_best_seats
tools.description: Find the best available seats on a flight matching user preferences like window, aisle, extra legroom, exit row, quiet zone, etc. Returns a ranked list and an interactive seatmap with recommended seats highlighted.

tools.name: fs_get_seat_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific seat on a flight, including characteristics, cabin class, availability, and pricing. Also renders the interactive seatmap.

tools.name: fs_search_flight
tools.description: Search for a flight and get fresh seatmap data. Requires a signed-in account — connect this server to sign in via OAuth. Paid plan users can fetch new flights not yet in our database. Uses a search credit. Returns an interactive seatmap with the results.

tools.name: fs_interactive_seat_finder
tools.description: Seat finder that recommends the best seats on a flight and renders an interactive seatmap. Good default when the user wants help finding a seat but hasn't specified preferences.

tools.name: fs_get_seat_reviews
tools.description: Get user-submitted reviews for a flight, optionally filtered to a specific seat. Shows ratings, comments, seat number, cabin, and helpfulness votes. Free — no auth required.

tools.name: fs_list_seat_alerts
tools.description: List all your seat alerts (active and inactive). Shows which seats you're being notified about, priority, days until flight, and last check time. Requires authentication.

tools.name: fs_create_seat_alert
tools.description: Create a seat alert that notifies you by email when a matching seat becomes available on a specific flight. tools.name: fs_delete_seat_alert
tools.description: Delete a seat alert by its ID. Use list_seat_alerts to find the alert ID. Requires authentication.

tools.name: fs_discover_more_flight_tools
tools.description: Discover other flight & travel MCP servers you can add to your client. Lists complementary remote MCPs covering award flights, airport delays/wait times, and lounges.

tools.name: sw_get_wifi_facts
tools.description: Best answer for "will this flight have WiFi". Predicts the WiFi provider for a flight number on a given date, with probability, the tail number expected to operate it, aircraft type, and the airline fleet fallback. Prefer this over get_flight_wifi.

tools.name: sw_get_flight_wifi
tools.description: Shorter WiFi lookup for a flight number: provider, confidence, airline, aircraft, and Starlink status. Use get_wifi_facts instead when you need the date, tail number, or reasoning.

tools.name: sw_get_airline_wifi
tools.description: WiFi providers an airline uses fleet-wide, plus a fleet summary and whether WiFi is free. Use when the question is about the airline rather than one flight.

tools.name: sw_get_rollouts
tools.description: Starlink and satellite WiFi rollout progress per aircraft type: status (complete, in_progress, planned, announced), fleet percentage, and expected completion. Omit airline_code for every tracked airline.

tools.name: sw_get_speed_stats
tools.description: Crowd-sourced in-flight WiFi speed reports: average download/upload Mbps, latency, and a per-provider breakdown. Use for "is the WiFi fast enough" questions. Pass a flight_number or an airline_code, not both.

tools.name: sw_get_tail_info
tools.description: WiFi provider history for one aircraft by tail number, including crowd-sourced reports and fleet assignment. Use when the exact airframe is known.

tools.name: sw_search_wifi
tools.description: Free-text search across airlines and flights when you only have a name or partial term. Use a specific tool instead when you already have a flight number, airline code, or tail number.

tools.name: sw_list_airlines
tools.description: Every airline SeatWiFi tracks, with its WiFi providers. Large response — use search_wifi or get_airline_wifi when you know which airline you want.

tools.name: lounge_search_lounges
tools.description: Search airport lounges worldwide by name, airport name, IATA code, city, or country. Returns matching lounges with amenities, access methods, and ratings. Use this to find specific lounges or discover lounges in a location.

tools.name: lounge_get_airport_lounges
tools.description: Get all airport lounges at a specific airport by IATA code. Returns every lounge at the airport with terminal location, amenities, access methods, and ratings.

tools.name: lounge_get_lounge_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific airport lounge by its slug. Returns full description, amenities, access methods, opening hours, capacity, ratings, and reviews count.

tools.name: lounge_find_lounges_by_access
tools.description: Find all airport lounges accessible with a specific credit card, membership program, airline club, alliance status, or ticket class. For example, find all lounges you can access with your Amex Platinum or Priority Pass membership.

tools.name: lounge_list_access_methods
tools.description: List all available lounge access methods including credit cards (Amex Platinum, Chase Sapphire Reserve, etc.), membership programs (Priority Pass, LoungeKey, etc.), airline clubs, alliance status levels, and ticket classes.

tools.name: lounge_list_networks
tools.description: List all lounge networks (Priority Pass, LoungeKey, DragonPass, Plaza Premium, Amex Centurion) with their descriptions and total lounge counts.

tools.name: lounge_get_network_lounges
tools.description: Get all lounges in a specific lounge network. Returns every lounge that accepts a particular network membership (e.g. all Priority Pass lounges worldwide).

tools.name: lounge_discover_more_flight_tools
tools.description: Discover other flight & travel MCP servers you can add to your client. tools.name: lounge_get_my_profile
tools.description: Get your Airport Lounge List profile — username, stats (reviews, visits, wishlisted lounges), and recent activity.

tools.name: lounge_get_my_passport
tools.description: Get your lounge passport — stats (lounges visited, airports, countries, reviews), country stamps, full visit history, and your reviews. Includes a shareable passport URL when your profile is public.

tools.name: lounge_get_my_reviews
tools.description: Get your lounge reviews, including pending ones. Returns rating, content, approval status, and lounge info.

tools.name: lounge_write_review
tools.description: Write a review for a lounge. Requires the lounge slug, a rating (1-5), and review text (min 10 characters).

tools.name: lounge_update_review
tools.description: Update your review of a lounge — change the rating and/or the text. Identify the review by lounge_slug.

tools.name: lounge_delete_review
tools.description: Delete your review of a lounge. Identify it by lounge_slug.

tools.name: lounge_get_my_visits
tools.description: Get your visited lounges list with dates and notes.

tools.name: lounge_mark_lounge_visited
tools.description: Log a lounge visit (check in). Identify the lounge by its slug OR by lounge_name + airport_iata. Optionally add a 1-5 rating and notes. Idempotent: logging the same lounge on the same date updates the existing visit's rating/notes instead of creating a duplicate.

tools.name: lounge_update_visit
tools.description: Update one of your logged lounge visits — change the rating, notes, or date. Identify the visit by lounge_slug; if you have multiple visits to the same lounge, pass visited_at to pick the one to update.

tools.name: lounge_delete_visit
tools.description: Delete one of your logged lounge visits. Identify it by lounge_slug; pass visited_at to pick a specific date if you have multiple visits to the same lounge.

tools.name: lounge_get_my_wishlist
tools.description: Get your lounge wishlist — lounges you want to visit.

tools.name: lounge_add_to_wishlist
tools.description: Add a lounge to your wishlist. Idempotent — adding a lounge already on your wishlist is a no-op.

tools.name: lounge_remove_from_wishlist
tools.description: Remove a lounge from your wishlist.

tools.name: cards_list_cards
tools.description: List credit cards in the database. Returns compact summaries (id, fees, welcome bonus value, top multipliers). Use get_card for full details.

tools.name: cards_get_card
tools.description: Get full details for a single card, including all multipliers, all benefits, welcome bonus, and source URL.

tools.name: cards_compare_cards
tools.description: Compare 2–4 cards side by side: annual fees, welcome bonuses, top multipliers, and total benefit credits. Pass card ids from list_cards.

tools.name: cards_find_cards_for_category
tools.description: Find cards with the best earning multiplier for a spend category (e.g. "dining", "groceries", "petrol", "travel"). Returns cards sorted by multiplier descending.

tools.name: cards_rank_welcome_bonuses
tools.description: List current welcome bonuses sorted by point/mile value descending. Optionally filter by spend achievability.

evidence.snippet: Revoke a previously connected integration. The OAuth tokens are deleted from ATF storage.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "viator_search_experiences" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
